label: same-definition-version-context-only
derivation: The selected descriptor and absent annotations are identical. A separately authored synthetic version label changes, but server-version context is outside the snapshot input contract and cannot change the selected-definition relation.
other_fields: Context and descriptor/annotation identifiers, profile strings and diagnostic source indexes must be checked against the actual projection/source bindings. Their computed values are intentionally not copied from the Gooo implementation here. Parent should use the independent Go oracle for the complete 32-field decision and retain all results.
limitations: The version labels are fictional context, not initialize responses or captured server evidence.
Does not establish that server behavior, permissions, origin or implementation stayed unchanged.
Does not prove that a host reconnected, refreshed its cache or received a notification.
